scientific_integrity: All displayed finite face sets, acyclic matchings and integer Morse differentials are reconstructible by the bundled standard-library checker. The stated classification is for the specific 12-vertex graph, not an infinite family. The ordinary cutoff-one sphere is previously known. Persistence maps are determined over F_2 only. The endpoints at cutoffs 8..12 follow from the graph being four-vertex-connected and classical skeleton homotopy.
scientific_limitations: One finite graph; no arbitrary-family theorem.
The persistent barcode uses coefficients in F_2; integral inclusion maps are not claimed.
Bibliographic priority is conditional on inspected literature; independent expert validation has not been performed.
